rulesClauses: At the beginning of your end phase, sacrifice an Elysian object or banish an Elysian card from your hand or memory. If you do neither, destroy Dante.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. DanteHematicUpkeep was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the optional sacrifice/banish (MZMAYCHOOSE answered PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods() skip the handler and its decline branch (DestroyDanteChampion) never ran: Dante survived the upkeep he was supposed to fail (live repro on HEAD: Dante still on the field, graveyard empty). Fix: dontSkipOnPass:1 at the queue site.
